countPolicy: Profile/strip records and spatial/name groups are not distinct bridge counts; divided carriageways, revisions and lower/upper road labels may describe the same crossing.
sourceCoverageLimit: Finite mapped-road/near-water/bridge-edge screen, not certification of every road elevation in Mississauga. Literal water intersections alone miss crossings because City water polygons are cut around bridge footprints.
nativeAcquisitionYears: Primary source acquisitions 2015,2018,2023 as recorded per patch; overview dates are excluded from acquisition claims.

Native plane is only 0.1 to 0.4 m above the coarse DTM, so no bridge lift is warranted.

Derry Road East watercourse: native paved road body is continuous and closely matches DTM. Sparse high edge returns do not demonstrate a deck sag; preserve source road. Culvert versus filled crossing construction is not proven by the 2D map alone. Follow-up comparison to the model 10 m DTM found no supported difference above 1 m in the sampled clear-pavement subset; this is separate from canopy returns.

Second Derry Road East watercourse: native road-body DSM–DTM median difference about 0.02 m and 90th percentile within 30 m about 0.10 m. No coherent elevated deck deficit is demonstrated; preserve road. Follow-up comparison to the model 10 m DTM found no supported difference above 1 m in the sampled clear-pavement subset; this is separate from canopy returns.
